objective: Measure repeatability of paired continue-versus-resample benefit under fresh policy seeds before investing further in benefit predictors.
selection: Exactly two fit t60 cases per task, sort SHA256(seed_stability_20261014:+pair_id), take first two. Selection reads no outcomes or model scores. Original full results remain intact; this is a separate fit-only repeated-seed study, never replacement or resampling of prior tests.
primary_comparison: D_ir = success(resample5)-success(continue_a), 20 roots x3 independent fresh-seed pairs. B is repeated A only, for 10 roots at replicate0.
policy_rng: Fresh fixed per-case base seed advanced12 draws for continue, independent resample seed advanced0; B exactly same as A. Original physical prefix and verified root image fixed.
metrics: Per-root three observed gains and within-root sample variance
Number of roots with varying gain
A/B success discordance and trajectory differences
Paired mean gain and task-cluster descriptive intervals
Actual policy calls, elapsed time and bytes

interpretation.high_variation: At least8/20 roots vary across3 seeds and all10 A/B success outcomes agree: supports seed-sensitive labels for this primitive on this fixed subset; motivates separately frozen expected-gain data protocol, not automatic deployment.
interpretation.low_variation: At most2/20 roots vary and all10 A/B outcomes agree: little support here for label randomness as dominant explanation; do not automatically enlarge repeated data.
interpretation.otherwise: Inconclusive; report exactly, no threshold edits/resampling. A/B discordance prevents pure policy-seed attribution.
interpretation.limits: K=3 is insufficient to certify per-root success probabilities. Twenty fit cases are not independent confirmation or full-benchmark success. Sampling by task is outcome-independent but the scope remains task-conditioned fit.

artifact_policy: Save all actual lossless model inputs, raw physics/action traces, metadata and independent audits. No new MP4s needed. All old videos/results untouched. Abort before cap, retain partials and do not claim full statistics.
authorization: Original research scope already authorized; only the paired effective-window increase requires user approval. Do not launch dependent GPU/simulation jobs before explicit approval.

math_checks.scope: Estimator algebra only; no evidence of actual VLA seed sensitivity.

worker_assignment: Within-task case index plus task parity modulo2;65 jobs and5 repeat controls on each worker, all seeds/methods of an original case remain on one worker.
